current_objective: Phase 10 Library/MIDI/Recording/Automation is complete and locked. Begin Phase 11 Distributed Libertas without allowing network/cloud execution to become local realtime musical authority.
known_limitations: Physical MIDI hardware remained NOT_EVALUATED because Web MIDI permission/hardware were unavailable; deterministic mapping and browser integration are proven.
Library v1 is browser-local IndexedDB rather than distributed storage.
Recording codec/container depends on browser MediaRecorder support.
Automation v1 covers continuous AudioParams, not discrete cue/hotcue/seek sequencing.
Networking is not permitted to own deck sourceFrame, Musical Clock, SYNC phase control, or render timing.
exact_next_action: Create module/distributed from this promoted Phase 10 authority, define the Phase 11 distributed contract and research evidence, then build bounded non-realtime session/capability/remote-work primitives with automated integration/runtime gates.
